editor.name: Name
editor.hint: Tip: use 'Locate mouse position…' to fill x/y (Enter confirms). Clicks require an 'activate' step before them; text filters require mode advanced.
highlight.label: {name} — Region {x},{y} {w}x{h}
help.window.start.proposito: Starts monitoring the current selection in this mode/profile.
help.window.start.exemplo: Pick the selection and mode 'advanced', then click Start; the session compares the ROI every 2 s.
help.window.stop.exemplo: Stop before switching selection, editing actions or using 'Run action'.
help.window.rearm.proposito: Recaptures the baseline without restarting the session.
help.window.rearm.exemplo: After fixing the panel by hand, re-arm to ignore the change already seen.
help.window.minimize.proposito: Hides the window while keeping the session and tray active.
help.window.minimize.exemplo: Minimize and reopen from the tray menu to free the monitored screen.
help.window.show_roi.proposito: Highlights the selection ROI on screen for ~2 s without changing its pixels.
help.window.show_roi.exemplo: Click to check the monitored region; it also works while the session is running.
help.window.selection_name.proposito: Display name of the selection; on confirm the file is renamed to the slug of the name.
help.window.selection_name.exemplo: Type 'Checking Download' and press Enter (file: checking-download.json).
help.window.mode.proposito: Chooses the strategy: light (color), default (hash) or advanced (OCR).
help.window.mode.exemplo: Use 'light' for large color changes and 'advanced' to read text in the ROI.
help.window.profile.proposito: Defaults/alerts/actions profile applied to the selection.
help.window.profile.exemplo: Switch to the 'night' profile to use a different minimum severity.
help.window.language.proposito: Chooses the GUI language from the package catalogs.
help.window.language.exemplo: Select 'English' and reopen the window to see the GUI in English.
help.window.arm.proposito: Actually runs the actions when the trigger fires (not rehearsal).
help.window.arm.exemplo: With actions armed, a click on the target button is replayed by the robot.
help.window.disarm.proposito: Returns to rehearsal: actions are only recorded, never executed.
help.window.disarm.exemplo: Disarm to test the flow without really clicking the application.
help.window.arm_for.proposito: Arms the actions for a limited time and disarms itself.
help.window.arm_for.exemplo: Arm for 5 min runs the triggers for five minutes, then returns to rehearsal.
help.window.run_action.proposito: Runs the selected actions once against the current ROI.
help.window.run_action.exemplo: With the session stopped, run it to validate the steps before monitoring.
help.window.new_target.proposito: Creates a selection by dragging the ROI over a window.
help.window.new_target.exemplo: Open the target app, click New Target and drag over the area to watch.
help.window.remove.proposito: Deletes the marked selections from the list.
help.window.remove.exemplo: Select an old selection with Ctrl and click Remove.
help.window.reload.proposito: Re-reads configuration and selections from disk.
help.window.reload.exemplo: After editing the YAML in your editor, click Reload.
help.window.open_yaml.proposito: Opens the config in the system default editor.
help.window.open_yaml.exemplo: Click to adjust profiles/alerts by hand.
help.window.captures.proposito: Opens the folder with the saved evidence (captures).
help.window.captures.exemplo: Check the baseline and change captures produced by the session.
help.window.evidence.proposito: Turns on capture recording on the baseline and on every change.
help.window.evidence.exemplo: Check it and restart the session to save an image on every alert.
help.window.actions_list.proposito: Marks which actions are valid on the next start.
help.window.actions_list.exemplo: Keep only 'Action_01_test' checked to monitor without running the others.
help.window.action_new.proposito: Opens the editor to create an action for this selection.
help.window.action_new.exemplo: Create the action 'open_report' with an activate step and a click.
help.window.action_edit.proposito: Edits an action defined in this selection.
help.window.action_edit.exemplo: Select the action and adjust the step order in the editor.
help.window.action_remove.proposito: Removes an action from the selection overrides.
help.window.action_remove.exemplo: Actions coming only from the YAML must be removed by editing the YAML.
help.window.test_alert.proposito: Sends a synthetic alert to one configured channel.
help.window.test_alert.exemplo: Select the selection, click Test alert…, pick 'teams' and send.
help.window.sound_choose.proposito: Picks a sound file to preview (nothing is written to the YAML).
help.window.sound_choose.exemplo: Pick an .mp3 and paste the 'file:' snippet into the YAML sound alert.
help.window.sound_play.proposito: Plays the chosen file without saving anything.
help.window.sound_play.exemplo: Listen to the .mp3 before pasting the path into the YAML.
help.window.sound_copy.proposito: Copies the 'file:' snippet to the clipboard.
help.window.sound_copy.exemplo: Paste it inside the sound alert in config.yaml.
help.window.text_watch.proposito: Alerts only when the text appears/disappears in the ROI (advanced mode).
help.window.text_watch.exemplo: Text 'DONE' with 'Appears' alerts when the OCR finds it in the ROI.
help.window.text_watch_expect.proposito: Chooses the transition that fires: appear or disappear.
help.window.text_watch_expect.exemplo: 'Disappears' alerts when the text is no longer found.
help.window.text_watch_case.proposito: When checked, matching distinguishes upper/lower case.
help.window.text_watch_accents.proposito: When checked (default), matching ignores accents on both sides.
help.test_alert.proposito: Lists the alerts of the selection/profile with type, state and destination.
help.test_alert.exemplo: Pick a channel and click Send test; the result appears below.
help.editor.name.proposito: Identifies the action in the list and in the summary.
help.editor.name.exemplo: Use 'close_popup' to recognize the action in the log.
help.editor.enabled.proposito: Unchecked, the action is kept but never runs.
help.editor.enabled.exemplo: Uncheck to disable without deleting the steps.
help.editor.severity_min.proposito: Only fires the action when the change reaches this severity.
help.editor.severity_min.exemplo: With severity_min=2, a severity-3 change fires; severity 1 is ignored.
help.editor.cooldown_s.proposito: Minimum time between two runs of the same action.
help.editor.cooldown_s.exemplo: cooldown_s=60 runs at most once per minute.
help.editor.settle_s.proposito: Waits after the steps for the screen to settle.
help.editor.settle_s.exemplo: settle_s=1.5 waits 1.5 s before comparing again.
help.editor.rebaseline.proposito: After running, adopts the new frame as baseline.
help.editor.rebaseline.exemplo: Check it when the action resolves the change and must not repeat.
help.editor.steps_list.proposito: Ordered sequence executed when the action fires.
help.editor.steps_list.exemplo: Drag to reorder or use Up/Down.
help.editor.step_kind.proposito: Step type: activate, click, move, key, type or wait.
help.editor.step_kind.exemplo: 'activate' focuses the window before any click.
help.editor.step_x.proposito: X coordinate relative to the chosen reference.
help.editor.step_x.exemplo: x=120 with ref=roi clicks 120 px right of the ROI corner.
help.editor.step_y.proposito: Y coordinate relative to the chosen reference.
help.editor.step_y.exemplo: y=40 with ref=window uses 40 px below the window top.
help.editor.step_ref.proposito: Origin of the coordinates: roi, window or screen.
help.editor.step_ref.exemplo: Prefer 'roi' so it stays valid if the window moves.
help.editor.step_button.proposito: Mouse button of the click step.
help.editor.step_button.exemplo: Use 'right' to open the context menu.
help.editor.step_clicks.exemplo: clicks=2 performs a double click at the point.
help.editor.step_keys.exemplo: ctrl+s saves; alt+f4 closes the window.
help.editor.step_text.exemplo: Type 'admin' to fill a user field.
help.editor.step_ms.exemplo: ms=1500 waits 1.5 s before the next step.
help.editor.step_add.proposito: Appends the step built in the form to the end of the list.
help.editor.step_add.exemplo: Build a 500 ms 'wait' and click Add step.
help.editor.step_remove.proposito: Removes the selected step from the list.
help.editor.step_remove.exemplo: Select the wrong step and remove it before saving.
help.editor.step_up.proposito: Moves the selected step one position up.
help.editor.step_up.exemplo: Put 'activate' before 'click' by moving it up.
help.editor.step_down.proposito: Moves the selected step one position down.
help.editor.step_down.exemplo: Postpone 'wait' by moving it down after the click.
help.editor.step_edit.proposito: Loads the selected step into the form to change it.
help.editor.step_edit.exemplo: Edit the coordinates and click Save change.
help.editor.step_duplicate.proposito: Creates a copy of the selected step right below it.
help.editor.step_duplicate.exemplo: Duplicate a click and adjust only the copy's y.
help.editor.step_locate.proposito: Grabs the mouse position and converts it to the current reference.
help.editor.step_locate.exemplo: Click, move the mouse to the point and confirm with Enter.
error.config.rects_not_list: {field} must be a list of [x, y, w, h]
error.config.target_not_mapping: each target must be a mapping
error.config.arm_durations_not_list: ui.arm_durations_min must be a list of minutes
error.config.arm_durations_positive: ui.arm_durations_min must contain only positive minutes
error.config.root_not_mapping: YAML root must be a mapping
error.config.version_unsupported: unsupported config version: {value}; use 1 or 2 (doc, section 12)
error.config.action_text_needs_advanced: action {name!r}: text_* filters require mode 'advanced' (OCR); selection is {mode!r}
error.config.alert_invalid_url: {field}.url must start with http:// or https://
error.action.not_text_list: {field} must be a list of texts
error.action.step_not_mapping: {field} must be a mapping with a single step
error.action.step_single: {field} must have exactly one step; got {keys}
error.action.changed_not_supported: {field}.changed: false is not supported in this phase
error.action.click_needs_activate: {field}: 'click' steps require an 'activate: true' step before them (explicit focus)
error.action.text_needs_advanced: {where}: text_* filters require mode 'advanced' (OCR); it is {mode!r}
error.selection.not_object: selection JSON must be an object
error.selection.name_invalid: selection name has no letters or digits
error.selection.name_too_long: selection name is too long (max {max} characters)

error.runtime.window_not_found: window not found: handle={handle}. Run 'list-windows' and redo the selection (the handle changes when the app restarts).
error.runtime.window_minimized: window minimized: no ROI to capture
error.runtime.roi_invalid: invalid ROI (outside the window or degenerate)
error.runtime.window_missing_after_selec: window not found after selection: handle={handle}
error.runtime.roi_outside_window: ROI {roi} does not fit inside window {window}; select a region fully inside the window
